name: A refusal by bd itself is a refusal, not an unknown outcome
aliases: may have committed for a refusal
summary: bd_refusals.refusal recognises a refusal bd makes before it writes by its form and its sentence together (bd 1.2.2's JSON error object or its Error line, with one of its own sentences); the endpoint's raw bd dispatch then answers return code 2 with bd's sentence and a kind, so the operation identity is released. EndpointBackend._checked answers 404 for not-found and 422 otherwise, and for a request that only read it answers 503 unavailable (nothing changed) instead of an uncertain outcome. ApiHandler._task_title checks a title on create and change (text, not blank, at most 500 characters) before the key is reserved. Anything not recognised stays uncertain.
